findings.description: move_card loads the card with self._store.card(card_id) and only checks editor rights on the target board. A user who is an editor of any board (or has no access to the card's current board at all) can pass the id of a card on a board they cannot edit, and it is detached from its source board and moved into their own board. This breaks the privacy rule stated in _require_role (non-members should get NotFound) and lets users remove or alter cards on other users' boards. The check should be applied to card.board_id before the move.
findings.suggestion: Call self._require_editor(card.board_id, actor_id) right after loading the card, in addition to the check on to_board_id.
findings.title: move_card never checks editor access on the source board
